title: augur.vigil-block/v0
description: The augur{} block of a vigil.summary/v0 document: what Augur publishes for Vigil to carry. Data only, no status: Augur's own state rides in verdicts[] and sources[]. Vigil copies the block unchanged and never lets it change overall. Additive within v0; consumers refuse an unknown major.

apiVersion.description: Document identity and major version, read the same way as every other authority document.

generated_at.description: The verdict's generated_at: the instant this block describes.

policy_sha256.description: Digest of the exact policy bytes the verdict was produced with, so a block names the rules it was judged by.

watchdog.description: The heartbeat. A block whose watchdog.seen is false is one Augur could not confirm is watching.

last_seen.description: The Watchdog alert's updatedAt, or null when it was not seen.

alertmanager_last_ok.description: Last time Alertmanager answered, from the verdict's sources[0].last_ok, or null when it never has. It is the one field that says how long Alertmanager has been silent.

counts.description: The alerts the verdict held, partitioned by effect on overall. total = raising.RED + raising.YELLOW + expected + suppressed. An alert is expected when expected is true, else suppressed when its status is suppressed, else raising by its severity.

total.description: The verdict's alerts[] length, merged by name and host.

alerts.description: Raising alerts only, capped at 50. Ordered by severity with RED first, then starts_at ascending, then host, then name. The block never carries GREEN, expected or suppressed alerts.

omitted.description: Raising alerts left out by the cap: raising.RED + raising.YELLOW - len(alerts). The cap can hide an alert, never the RED itself, which overall and verdicts[].severity carry independently.

slug.description: Public-safe identifier. unmapped is a value in this vocabulary.

name.description: The alert name, or unnamed when the label was not a valid identifier.

starts_at.description: The merged start, the latest reporting replica's start.

rule_id.description: The policy rule that decided the severity, or null when no rule matched and the default applied.

replicas.description: The views that reported this alert, sorted.

reasons.description: Per-alert reasons, sorted; the same closed enum as the verdict.

reason.description: Copied from verdict.v0.json, sorted. No code here equals one of Vigil's five.
